tools.name: calculate_pricing
tools.description: Return a pre-rebate Denver-metro installation price range for a specific system. Prices are RANGES, not quotes — a binding quote requires an in-home assessment. Use after get_pricer_templates to know which templateId and question keys to pass.

responses.description: Key/value answers to the template's questions

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Verify a Colorado ZIP code is inside UniColorado Heating & Cooling's Denver-metro service territory. Use this before recommending scheduling or pricing. Returns tier (core/extended), utility territory, and whether installs are accepted for that ZIP.

tools.name: get_pricer_templates
tools.description: List UniColorado's Quick Pricer templates — one per system category (heat pump, furnace, AC, mini-split, water heater, panel upgrade, EV charger). Use this to pick the right template before calling calculate_pricing.

tools.name: open_booking_form
tools.description: Return a schedule-page URL with UTM attribution preserved. This is how AI agents should hand users off to book a consultation: the user clicks the URL, fills the form in-browser (reCAPTCHA + attribution capture naturally), and UniColorado knows which AI sent the lead. Do NOT call submit_lead from an agent context — reCAPTCHA will silently drop it.

agent.description: Your agent identity for attribution reporting

content.description: Optional sub-topic that triggered this (e.g. xcel-rebate)
